questions.question: A personal flotation device (PFD) should be:
answers: USCG-approved, accessible, and worn as required
Used only as seat cushions always

questions.question: Navigation lights are required:
answers: Between sunset and sunrise and in restricted visibility

questions.question: The stand-on vessel should:
answers: Maintain course and speed unless collision cannot be avoided

questions.question: A red nun buoy typically marks:
answers: The left side of the channel when returning from sea (red right returning)

questions.question: Operating under the influence on the water is:
Before launching you should:
answers: Check weather, equipment, fuel, and file a float plan when appropriate

questions.question: When crossing another vessel's path, power-driven vessels generally:
answers: Give way to the vessel on their starboard (right)

questions.question: Propeller strike prevention includes:
answers: Leaving engine in gear near swimmers
Shutting off the engine near people in the water

questions.question: A sounding signal of five or more short blasts means:
answers: Doubt / danger / disagreement with another's intentions

questions.question: Anchoring safely requires:
answers: Dropping anchor while at full speed
Adequate scope and clearance from hazards/channels

questions.question: PWC (personal watercraft) operators should:
answers: Jump wakes close to other boats
Maintain lookout, obey speed/no-wake zones, and keep clear of swimmers
